t: Made for table saws and ideal for cutting hard wood, soft wood, plywood, chipboard and MDF. Specially formulated, highly compact Titanium Cobalt Carbide (TiCo) teeth. Provides a sharp edge and flawless finish with a long cutting life. Perma shield technology is a non-stick coating formulation that withstands the toughest applications. Provides thermal insulation, protects from corrosion and eliminates resin build-up, reducing downtime for cleaning.
